FACT_ID: sec05-F01 | anchor: A01
Starting means consulting the owner's manual, braking with the right foot, confirming park, keying on, and scanning fuel, ABS, and bag gauges [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F02 | anchor: A01
Moving means shifting to drive under braking, checking front, sides, and rear, signaling, then easing onto the accelerator with heel down and foot-top on the pedal [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F03 | anchor: A01
Stopping means mirror-checking the rear, swapping to the brake, and pressing steadily to a halt [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F04 | anchor: A01
The wheel always turns toward the intended travel direction, forward or reverse [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F05 | anchor: A01
Two-and-ten hand placement is retired as airbag-dangerous [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F06 | anchor: A01
Hands grip the wheel's outside at 3 and 9 with firm gentle fingers and raised thumbs, never from the inside or by the palms [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F07 | anchor: A01
Backing starts with a walk-around look since children and small objects hide from the seat [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F08 | anchor: A01
Reverse posture means braking into gear, left hand at 12, right arm over the seatback, and eyes through the rear glass [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F09 | anchor: A01
Mirrors aid backing but miss the zone directly behind [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F10 | anchor: A01
Reverse driving stays slow and gentle with slight steering toward the tail's path [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]

FACT_ID: sec05-F11 | anchor: A01
Turning reverses add quick front-side checks, and rear gaze holds until fully stopped [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0041]
